title: DINO-FIL: Multi-Layer Transformer Fusion for Generative Inpainting Forgery Localization
abstract: arXiv:2610.21780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose DINO-FIL, a transformer-based framework for pixel-level localization of generative image forgeries. The method leverages multi-layer representations from a pretrained DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 encoder combined with a lightweight fusion decoder to capture both semantic structure and fine-grained texture inconsistencies introduced by image editing. By aggregating intermediate transformer features across depths, the model improves sensitivity to subtle, spatially localized artifacts that are often missed by standard single-layer approaches. We evaluate DINO-FIL in a cross-dataset setting, training on B-Free and testing on Beyond the Brush, CocoGlide, TGIF, and SAGI-D. The model achieves strong generalization, outperforming existing baselines on average and on four of five evaluated datasets, while maintaining a high true negative rate on pristine images.

translated_title: DINO-FIL：用于生成式图像修复伪造定位的多层Transformer融合
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DINO-FIL，一个基于Transformer的框架，用于生成式图像伪造的像素级定位。该方法利用预训练DINOv3 ViT-H+/16编码器的多层表示，结合一个轻量级融合解码器，以同时捕获语义结构以及图像编辑引入的细粒度纹理不一致性。通过跨深度聚合中间Transformer特征，该模型提升了对细微的、空间上局部化的伪影的敏感性，而这类伪影通常会被标准的单层方法所遗漏。我们在跨数据集设置下评估DINO-FIL，即在B-Free上训练，并在Beyond the Brush、CocoGlide、TGIF和SAGI-D上测试。该模型展现出强大的泛化能力，在平均性能上以及五个评估数据集中的四个上超越了现有基线，同时在未篡改的原始图像上保持了较高的真负率。
tldr: 提出DINO-FIL框架，通过融合预训练DINOv3编码器的多层Transformer特征实现生成式图像伪造的像素级定位，在跨数据集评估中展现出优于现有基线的泛化能力。
